en: When the canary reached ten percent, the payment callback success rate dropped from 99.9 to 97, and it recovered after we rolled back. Comparing the two versions, the only changes were the log format and one timeout setting, from three seconds to one second. Downstream average response is only a few hundred milliseconds, so I can't figure out why the impact is so large.
